name: Research a replacement for Claude Design in design-cowork
objective: Return a ranked top 3 of replacements for Claude Design in design-cowork, each running in both claude and ocx claude, needing no vendor SaaS account or paid subscription, drivable by executor subagents, giving the operator a Claude-Design-like frames/cards surface, and keeping a persistent design memory so the design continues across rounds; with trade-offs and a recommendation on whether Claude Design stays as an optional path. No machinery changes.

review.note: Ranked top 3 (repo frames board, Storybook+addon-mcp, self-hosted Penpot) with sourced evidence; retire DesignSync loop, keep Claude Design as optional bundle import; no product/machinery change

acceptance.note: research-only: findings are a ranked report the operator reads; no operator-visible product or machinery change; adoption is a later operator-created phase
